blocks.text: Merchant of Record that handles payments, tax, and compliance globally

Paddle's Merchant of Record model is its defining feature. Instead of just processing payments, Paddle becomes the legal seller of your product. This means Paddle handles sales tax, VAT, and compliance across every jurisdiction - a burden that grows exponentially complex as you sell globally.

For SaaS companies, this removes an entire category of operational headaches. You do not need to register for tax in every state or country, calculate correct rates, file returns, or deal with tax audits on international sales. Paddle handles all of it.

The trade-off is slightly higher transaction fees compared to Stripe. But for many SaaS companies, the cost of Paddle is less than the alternative: hiring tax accountants, subscribing to tax calculation services, and dedicating engineering time to compliance infrastructure.
